strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.general.title: General
strings.settings.general.subtitle: Language, reading comfort, everyday workspace, and session defaults.
strings.settings.general.lang_hint: Drop any BCP-47 JSON file (e.g. ja-JP.json, fr-FR.json) into ~/.omp/desktop/locales/ to add or override languages.
strings.settings.general.auto_compact_desc: Summarize earlier turns automatically before approaching context window limits.
strings.settings.general.fast_mode_desc: Prefer low-latency priority endpoints when supported by the active model.
strings.settings.general.auto_update_desc: Quietly check GitHub Releases once on launch without interrupting active work.
strings.settings.providers.title: Providers & Accounts
strings.settings.providers.subtitle: Sign in via OAuth or add custom OpenAI / Anthropic / local gateways into models.yml.
strings.settings.providers.oauth_empty: Connect to OMP engine to inspect OAuth providers.
strings.settings.providers.no_match: No OAuth providers match that filter.
strings.settings.providers.field_key: API Key or Env Var (e.g. MY_KEY or sk-...)
strings.settings.providers.custom_empty: No custom providers in models.yml yet. Click 'Add Provider' for OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama, or any gateway.
strings.settings.models.title: Models & Roles
strings.settings.models.subtitle: Assign OMP model roles in config.yml and choose default reasoning effort.
strings.settings.models.quick_pick: QUICK-PICK FROM DISCOVERED CATALOG (SETS DEFAULT ROLE)
strings.settings.models.default_thinking_desc: Starting reasoning depth for new threads (saved to config.yml: defaultThinkingLevel).
strings.settings.appearance.title: Appearance & Typography
strings.settings.appearance.subtitle: Curated OKLCH mineral palettes, live font selection, and subtle motion controls.
strings.settings.appearance.custom_font_placehol: Or enter any installed system font name...
strings.settings.appearance.particles_desc: Send lift bursts & subtle welcome ambient starlight.
strings.settings.appearance.reduced_motion_desc: Settle springs and shaders immediately with zero continuous particle motion.
strings.settings.appearance.mica_desc: System translucent desktop surface (applies on next launch).
strings.settings.safety.title: Tools & Approval Policy
strings.settings.safety.subtitle: Controls when OMP pauses for confirmation before modifying files or running shell commands.
strings.settings.safety.always_ask.title: Always Ask
strings.settings.safety.always_ask.desc: Auto-approves read-only tools; prompts before every write or shell command.
strings.settings.safety.cached.title: Ask & Remember
strings.settings.safety.cached.desc: Prompts on writes with option to remember per file or folder in approval-cache.db.
strings.settings.safety.write.title: Auto-Write, Ask Shell
strings.settings.safety.write.desc: Allows file edits freely; prompts before executing bash / terminal commands.
strings.settings.safety.yolo.title: Autonomous (YOLO)
strings.settings.safety.yolo.desc: Runs all tools autonomously except explicitly restricted folders or per-tool overrides.
strings.settings.ecosystem.title: MCP, Extensions & Skills
strings.settings.ecosystem.subtitle: Manage MCP servers in mcp.json and inspect discovered OMP plugins.
strings.settings.ecosystem.discovered_empty: No custom extensions, skills, or rules discovered in current workspace or ~/.omp/agent.
strings.settings.engine.title: Engine & Wire Diagnostics
strings.settings.engine.subtitle: Configure OMP runtime binary, profile, and inspect live RPC v2 framing.
strings.settings.engine.wire_stats: PID {pid}  ·  Protocol v{proto}  ·  GPU {gpu}  ·  {frames} frames logged
strings.settings.engine.no_logs: No live RPC frames logged yet (Showcase or disconnected).
